versions.name: Aubrey Watzek Lodge
versions.summary: A Cascade Pacific Council winter recreation lodge on the flank of Mount Hood, leased from the national forest, with large dormitory sleeping, industrial kitchens, and a central fireplace, supporting snowshoe and cold-weather unit camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Cascade Pacific Council winter camp page (confirmed a distinct CPC winter lodge on Mount Hood). The scout-camp-map coordinates fell in downtown Portland; re-placed by geocoding the Mount Hood address. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council's winter camp page; classified as a weekend/winter camping lodge; features unsurveyed.
